channel.title: rheophile.ca — dev log
channel.description: Posts that record how rheophile10 builds plastron and other reactive, offline-first tools.

item.title: Demand-paged SQLite in the browser: wa-sqlite + an IndexedDB VFS
item.description: sql.js loads the whole database into memory; ordinary SQLite doesn't. A TypeScript demo puts the demand-paged model back in the browser — SQLite whose pages live in IndexedDB, read on demand, with FTS5 and CRDT in the same build — running from a double-clicked file:// page.

item.title: Cryptographic RBAC on a CRDT database — records that a group can keep, with no single keyholder as a target
item.description: localRbac enforces role-based access control with cryptography only, in a local-first CRDT database that a group edits offline and merges. Shamir secret sharing splits the master key k-of-n, and thus no single keyholder is a target for coercion.

item.title: One HTML file compared with a web application: sample intake without the long IT approval process
item.description: A web application is easy to build, but IT approval for a server, a login, and a database is difficult. One offline HTML file with SQLite and Web Crypto is a free intermediate step, and its QR code removes transcription.

item.title: RheoServ Waumpaum — a credit-union core in one HTML file
item.description: RheoServ Waumpaum is a credit-union core banking system in one encrypted HTML file. A CRDT merges the offline changes of the operators, and institutions settle with waumpaums.

item.title: Hide a plastron link in an image with ChaosEdgeSteg
item.description: A plastron sheetapp hides a plastron.ca share link in a PNG that you can post to X. The upstream ChaosEdgeSteg Python code runs without changes in Pyodide.

item.title: An offline HRIS for a community police office
item.description: A proof of concept puts CRDT SQLite in one HTML file to merge HR data offline. The demo shows a fictional Juárez police office, and the plan is to use the same patterns in plastron.

item.title: 曳尾塗中 — drag your tail in the mud
item.description: The tortoise story of Zhuangzi in traditional Chinese. Click a character to see its decomposition tree with English glosses.
